During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] '''regiment''' of the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]] served under [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], stopping Separatist [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] invasions across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==Description==
Under one of<ref name="SW30C" /> twenty-one [[Legion/Legends|legions]]<ref name="Regiment structure" /> out of the [[Fourth Outer Rim Army|4th Sector Army's]]<ref name="GGR" /> [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]], the [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] lead by<ref name="SW30C" /> [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]]<ref name="GGR" /> [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] totalled 2,304 [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]],<ref name="Regiment structure" /> with added support personnel.<ref name="Support personnel" /> The regiment had a [[clone regimental commander]] acting as the second-in-command of the unit,<ref name="Regimental commander" /> along with a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] as one of its [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="Colonel" /> Following the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Order of Battle/Legends|Order of Battle]], the regiment had four clone [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] under its command.<ref name="Regiment structure" />

At least one clone trooper within Mace Windu's regiment wore customized<ref name="SW30C" /> [[Synthmesh/Legends|synthmesh]] [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]], with a [[Kama/Legends|kama]], [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]],<ref name="RoTS VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> pouches, a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]], and two [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistol]] [[Holster/Legends|holsters]]. The armor had [[Color/Legends|purple]] and light blue markings. The trooper was equipped with a<ref name="SW30C" /> [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]]<ref name="RoTS VD" /> and a pair of<ref name="SW30C" /> [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]].<ref name="RoTS VD" />

==History==
As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] raged in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], following its start at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="SWE2">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Mace Windu put aside [[Gender/Legends|his]] diplomatic mantle to become a High [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]], and eventually took control of one of the clone trooper regiments out of the 4th Sector Army's Galactic Marines. During the war, Mace Windu and his regiment fought on several [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] to stop the Separatists from invading them, and were at one point within the<ref name="SW30C" /> [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="SWE2" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MaceWinduMarine_RebelScum.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Mace Windu and one of his Galactic Marines, in their original packaging.]]
Mace Windu's regiment of Galactic Marines was created by [[Hasbro]] for their [[2007]] [[Wikipedia:Target|Target]]-exclusive ''[[Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection]]'s'' [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] line of action figures. The set containing the regiment shows the incorrect figure on its box art&mdash;a trooper with armor similar to that of a Galactic Marine&mdash;while the figure is a repaint of a Galactic Marine.<ref name="SW30C" />
